subject: [URGENT] 4 H-3 dedup collisions blocking release gate
body:
GR,

node tests/cross-exam-verify.js is throwing 4 HARD FAILURES. These block the release gate (tests/release-readiness-check.js Gate 3). Motor-city-math publish is blocked until fixed.

H-3 failures (same answer, same question number, different exams):
  Q4: retake-practice-5 vs retake-practice-9 — both answer 9
  Q6: retake-practice-2 vs retake-practice-5 — both answer 8
  Q11: retake-practice-3 vs retake-practice-5 — both answer 25
  Q15: MVP vs retake-practice-5 — both answer 20

All 4 collisions involve retake-practice-5. Change the numerical answers in RP5 for Q4, Q6, Q11, and Q15 to new unique values.

Verify fix: node tests/cross-exam-verify.js — must exit 0.
Then: node tests/release-readiness-check.js — should return 19/19.

This is the same H-3 class GF flagged in the dedup risk brief 2026-02-23.

- GF
